events.body:
## Context

`compliance_checker.py` sets `current_score = 0` only in `__init__`, so calling `check_compliance` twice on one instance (README "As a Python Module") adds the scores. A GitHub URL with fewer than 2 path parts silently scores 0 with no error. CONTRIBUTING says `pytest tests/`, but there's no `tests/` and no tests.tsv row.

## What to do

1. Reset `current_score` at the start of `check_compliance`; set `results["error"]` for incomplete URLs.
2. Add `tests/test_compliance_checker.py` with a fake repo object (stub `get_repo`/`get_contents`) so it runs offline.
3. Add `blt-owasp-wich\tpython\tpip install -r requirements.txt pytest && python -m pytest tests -q` to `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`.

> **Note:** Don't change which checks pass or how they're scored, and don't touch `public/` styling (under review in #39).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two calls give the same score
- [ ] A bad URL gives an `error`
- [ ] At least 5 offline tests
- [ ] tests.tsv row passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-wich
```
